title: Claude Code in PhD Lab's container uses the researcher's existing Claude sign-in
user_story: As the owner, signed in to Claude Code on my computer, I want Claude Code turns in PhD Lab to work without signing in again and to stay signed in for good, and its status to be true.

requirements.description: prepare('claude_code') copies this computer's current Claude subscription access token (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude/.credentials.json) into the project runtime home, refreshed from the host on every prepare.

The copy never contains the refresh token, so the container cannot rotate and sign out the host's sign-in; the host file is never modified; a sign-in made inside the runtime (/login, with its own refresh token) is kept.

CONNECTED only when the container can sign in (own runtime sign-in, or a host access token valid for more than a minute); an expired host token or a keychain-only sign-in is AUTH_EXPIRED with the action to take. Readiness reads files only and never starts the CLI.

A `claude setup-token` token saved in Settings (gateway.claude_code_oauth_token, validated sk-ant-oat01-…, masked by the API, removable) signs the container in for about a year; when set, the host's short token is not copied and an earlier copy is removed.

The container launcher runs as a separate process without the project configuration: the parent passes the token in that process's environment (ClaudeCodeConnector.env, external terminal); the launcher writes it to a private --env-file removed after the run; never on a command line or in the plan; malformed inherited values are ignored; Codex never receives it.

nonfunctional: Tests never read the researcher's real CLI sign-ins (tests/_env.py isolates CODEX_HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)
Settings UI: frontend/src/features/settings/GatewayConnections.test.tsx (token field is a password input, copy `claude setup-token`, save trims, remove, never prefilled)
Settings shows the connections panel (SettingsContracts.test.tsx: 'shows the CLI connections with the Claude long-lived token in the models tab'); a malformed shared catalog never crashes Settings
preconditions: Claude Code signed in on this computer with a Claude subscription
acceptance_criteria: Live: Claude Code CLI turn completed in the container after the fix (previously 'Not logged in')
Readiness detail says the sign-in is shared
Live: with a long-lived token the container turn completed with no credentials file in the container home (as-d3b844c9c2)

scenarios.expected: A renewed host token replaces the copy
No refresh token in the copy; host bytes unchanged
A runtime /login is not overwritten and counts as CONNECTED
Missing or malformed host sign-in seeds nothing
An unchanged token is not rewritten
Fresh: CONNECTED; expired: AUTH_EXPIRED (open Claude Code); none: AUTH_EXPIRED (/login)
auth_state never starts the CLI (run_cli raises if called)
Stored, masked in the API, masked value keeps it, malformed tokens refused, removable
Env file holds the token, removed after the run; not in argv or plan; no seeded copy
Token reaches a launcher with no configuration through its environment; injection-shaped value ignored
Codex runs get no Claude env file
CONNECTED with a long-lived token even when the host is signed out

recovery: Never copy the refresh token to fix a failure. TASK-CLAUDE-SIGNIN-663, max three cycles.
test_environment: Temporary CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, isolated config and runtime home in a disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR; docker and subprocess faked in unit tests. Live checks in docs/qa/evidence/claude-signin-663/README.md.
